processing: Selected one of four overlapping character variants.
Retargeted the Mixamo rifle locomotion, reaction, and death clip set.
Removed the stale embedded Beretta; the separately licensed AK-47 is attached by structured prefab data.
Converted embedded textures to WebP at quality 86.
Added the Mixamo Firing Rifle clip (FiringRifle) with scripts/import-fps-enemy-animations.mjs --clips "Firing Rifle.fbx"; the rig carried no firing pose before it.
